why: the stored record -- name plus `ParameterValue` -- returned by `ParameterServer::iter()` and `get_parameter()`, and what the `~/list_parameters` / `~/describe_parameters` handlers walk. rclrs never materialises one because its store is a map behind the node handle. Ours must, because the handlers iterate the static array without allocating an intermediate collection. C has the same record as `nros_parameter_t` and C++ has none. This row covers `Parameter::new`/`bool`/`integer`/`double`/`string`/`name`/`param_type`, which are constructors and accessors over those two fields.
